body:
Conditional κ = `753508664880762517753401/10^27` = **7.53508664880762517753401e-4**, +0.0817 % over [#310](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/310)'s w3 word (7.52893499605334868002344e-4), +0.268 % over [#309](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/309).

One self-contained package, `research/w3-target-prefix/` (#310's `w3-bitword` package with one transcript stage inserted), with its own workflow; branched from `main`, no existing file changed. Vendored files are stored byte-for-byte (`.gitattributes`).

**Full replay: PASS** on the committed package (`verify.py --output`, ~9 minutes locally): both prerequisite source verifiers (PR249 eight-stage, PR256/PR233 complex) fresh, the target-prefix stage, recompaction, legality, all 23,627 global and 22,172 compact F₂ columns, bank allocation, 21,054 changed charts, geometry admission, exact price (two engines, eight ordinary levels, 47 strict constraints, adjacent grid point rejected), finite invoice, complex guard and the cross-binding `finish.py`; package hashes unchanged before and after; prints `PASS conditional kappa = 753508664880762517753401/1000000000000000000000000000`.

## Change

**209 exact F₂ target-prefix squares on w3** — eumemic's [#268](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/268) mechanism in the native-transcript stage form of [#273](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/273)/[#281](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/281) (`code/target_prefix.py`), inserted right after #310's source binding and inert-role deletion. The w3 word admits the same square structure as the source527/gen4/gen5 words: in each of 209 squares of four data targets every rank-20 entrance helper is read by exactly two of the four, so the dependent target's frame-20 prefix response is the F₂ sum of its three square-mates'. Its 1,057 frame-20 reads are omitted; it receives `t −= p_j` at the zero frame at the cut (record 876,399) and `t += p_j` at the square's common nondegenerate 21-dimensional frame at the close (1,254 setup/restore additions): ZERO →(20)→(1)→ 21 becomes ZERO →(21)→ 21.

Local histogram delta {1: −209, 2: −7, 3: −1, 4: −4, 8: −2, 9: −4, 12: −2, 13: +4, 17: −1, 18: −7, 20: −199, 21: +209}: 223 fewer local calls (3,669,720 five-stage calls) at unchanged rank mass 398,897; endpoints, entrances, the bank allocation (3,026,400 assignments, stock 810,615 / 162,123, normalizer 787, selector charge 571,950,677,600) are unchanged. The stage recomputes every literal prefix dependency from the actual transcript, rebuilds every MOVE, checks nesting, fixed endpoints, COPY lifetimes, nondegenerate endpoint bases, both reflected ledgers and the forward/inverse all-column F₂ replays with an omitted-setup control; `code/recompact.py` rebuilds the compact stream with the same freed-role map. Everything downstream is #310's checker chain fresh on the new word (word hash `de63e0a3…`, 934,582 ADDs, 21,054 changed projector charts at ≤ 342 factors, finite coefficient 58,167,289,165,918,601 < 2⁸⁰, two exact moment engines, eight ordinary levels, 47 strict constraints, adjacent 10⁻²⁷ point rejected). Re-pinned literals: `code/price.py` (word hash, ADDs, calls, κ), `code/admit_geometry.py` and `code/finish.py` (chart count, coefficient).
